blocks.text: Giovanni Lopez takes over as DPWH chief while Vince Dizon returns to the Department of Transportation. | PNA file photo MANILA – President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. is sending Vince Dizon back to the Department of Transportation – Philippines and transferring Giovanni Lopez to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Malacañang announced Monday. Presidential Communications Office Secretary Lino Cayetano said the swap aims to accelerate transport services and sustain reforms at the agency embroiled in a flood-control corruption controversy. “We are shifting gears to accelerate reform.
